title: Continuous tuning
summary: A collection of nouns and verbs for tuning a small open model at one narrow task, round after round, and keeping a change only when a rule committed before any scoring says so: owned made-up examples, curation against contamination, a frozen test registered by its hashes, a QLoRA or LoRA adapter trained on free or local GPUs, strict exact-match evaluation with a paired bootstrap, a reload check, a recomputable decision, and a private champion pointer that moves or stays.
boundaries: Keeping the champion is a valid outcome; a promotion moves only a private pointer, never a deployment, admission or serving change.
Owned made-up data only, or data whose license and consent permit training.
Training uses the worker's own or free GPUs within their terms; this pack grants no compute or spending.
Importing the pack writes nothing and enqueues nothing.

value.worked_example: Made-up, recomputed by the code's tests: 40 frozen rows and their real receipt, then two rounds under the real pre-registered rule. Round 1 promotes; round 2 keeps the champion because a guard holds against a real-looking gain.
value.order_note: check-reload runs before decide-promotion, because the rule's integrity checks need its result.

nouns.title: Guardrail: the rule and the test are registered before any scoring
nouns.category_reason: A guardrail is a reusable rule every verb in this work follows, with the check that proves it.

value.rule: Commit the promotion rule and register every frozen test set's hashes before any candidate is scored on them. Changing either makes a new version, and results scored under the old version keep their meaning.
value.how_it_is_checked: Every decision pins a rule and frozen test receipts whose registration times precede every evaluation run it uses, and whose digests recompute from their files.

nouns.title: Guardrail: no training row shares a fingerprint with a held-out row
nouns.category_reason: A guardrail is a reusable rule every verb in this work follows, with the check that proves it.

value.rule: No training row may share its exact content, its normalized request or its template shape with any held-out row, and whole families, templates and phrasings sit in exactly one split. Rejected rows are kept with their reasons.
value.how_it_is_checked: Every accepted batch and frozen test receipt records zero shared fingerprints of each kind and zero rows from a held-out family.

nouns.title: Guardrail: owned data only
nouns.category_reason: A guardrail is a reusable rule every verb in this work follows, with the check that proves it.

value.rule: Train only on owned made-up data, or on data whose license and the consent of the people in it permit training. Never train on a provider's outputs when its terms forbid it, on private history, on execution reports, or on personal data.
value.how_it_is_checked: Every example batch records model_generated false and no external source, or names the license and consent that permit training on each source.

nouns.title: Guardrail: keeping the champion is valid, and a promotion moves only a private pointer
nouns.category_reason: A guardrail is a reusable rule every verb in this work follows, with the check that proves it.

value.rule: Keeping the champion is a valid outcome, never a failure to fix by rerunning. A promotion moves only the private champion pointer the next round compares against; it deploys, admits, publishes and serves nothing. A person decides any roll back, with the reason on the record.
value.how_it_is_checked: Every pointer change names a decision with outcome promote_candidate, or a roll back recorded by a person's key, and is written by compare-and-set.

nouns.title: Guardrail: the base model's license and the compute's terms are followed
nouns.category_reason: A guardrail is a reusable rule every verb in this work follows, with the check that proves it.

value.rule: The base model's license and acceptable use policy apply to every adapter trained from it, and adapters stay private unless that license and the owner allow otherwise. Free or shared GPUs are used only within their terms and quotas, and no spending goes beyond the worker's own allowance.
value.how_it_is_checked: Every adapter card names the base model's license and its obligations, records distribution private and admitted false, and records the GPU, its memory peak and the minutes used.

nouns.title: Strict exact-match scoring of typed replies
nouns.category_reason: A zero-call deterministic procedure: the same inputs always give the same result.

steps: Parse the reply as one JSON object; prose, code fences or a second object make it invalid.
Canonicalize the reply and the label the same way: sorted keys, numbers compared by value so 300 equals 300.0, and optional arguments that restate the schema default or pass null dropped.
The reply is exactly right only when the canonical forms are equal; an invalid reply, an error or a timeout is wrong.
Also record JSON validity, schema validity, type correctness, the rate of stringified typed values, refusal accuracy, refusal recall and the false-refusal rate.
A lenient diagnostic that accepts fences and prose is recorded beside the strict score and never decides anything.

nouns.title: Paired bootstrap of exact match on the same frozen rows
nouns.category_reason: A zero-call deterministic procedure: the same inputs always give the same result.

steps: Pair the candidate's and the champion's exact results row by row; each difference is 1, 0 or -1.
Draw each resample's row indices with replacement from SHA-256 over a counter, seeded by the rule's seed string and the row count, so any language repeats the same draws.
Average each resample's differences, sort the averages, and take the rule's percentile interval.
Report the mean difference, the interval, and the rows that improved and regressed.
value.draws: Draw("paired-bootstrap", seed, n): the seed is SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of that list; draw k is SHA-256 of the seed followed by k as 8 big-endian bytes, and its first 8 bytes, big-endian, modulo n give the row.
value.power_note: About 18 percent of rows flip between two close adapters in the published runs; at that rate a 150-row test detects a true 5-point gain only about 31 percent of the time, and 80 percent power needs about 560 rows.

nouns.title: Contamination check: three fingerprints per row
nouns.category_reason: A zero-call deterministic procedure: the same inputs always give the same result.

fingerprints.exact: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the request text, the offered tools and the label.
fingerprints.request: SHA-256 of the request text, lowercased with whitespace collapsed.
fingerprints.shape: SHA-256 of the request with every slot value masked, so the same template with other values matches.

steps: Compute the three fingerprints for every training row and every held-out row with the generator's own normalization and masks.
Count shared fingerprints of each kind between training rows and each held-out set, and count training rows from held-out families.
Reject a training row that shares any fingerprint, or repeats an accepted row's exact or request fingerprint, and keep it in the batch's rejected list with its reason.

nouns.title: Reload equivalence check for a saved adapter
nouns.category_reason: A deterministic check recipe: greedy regeneration from pinned files gives the same replies.

steps: Load a fresh copy of the base model from weights whose digests match its noun.
Attach the saved adapter from its files, whose digests match the adapter card.
Regenerate the probe rows greedily and require every reply to equal the reply recorded at evaluation, byte for byte.
Disable the adapter and require the replies to equal the base model's.
Hash the base weights again and require them unchanged.
value.passes_when: Every probe reply matches, the disabled adapter reproduces the base, and the base digests are unchanged.
value.model_calls: Local greedy generation of the probe rows only; no provider call.

nouns.category_reason: A fingerprinted evaluation summary: published, dated results with their sources.

value.summary: Each result is one made-up typed tool-call task with one seed per configuration. They show the loop measuring gains from little owned data and keeping out regressions by a rule fixed in advance; they do not show general improvement.

results.test: frozen 150-row made-up test over tool families never trained on
results.kept_out: Round 2 (twice the data) did not beat the champion; round 4 raised dev but not test, and its schema validity fell to 0.617.
Round 2 scored 0.793, but its schema validity fell 0.025 against a 0.02 limit.

results.test: a fresh 150-row made-up holdout, its hashes registered before scoring
results.paired: +0.060, paired bootstrap 95 percent interval +0.020 to +0.107; 10 rows improved, 1 regressed
results.kept_out: Nothing: 12 of 12 rule checks passed, and a fresh reload regenerated 8 of 8 rows exactly. Nothing was promoted, admitted or registered; the adapter weights are not published.
results.method: A QLoRA adapter trained on free cloud GPUs with made-up examples only.
results.source: Published evidence; its address is in this pack's descriptor provenance notes.

limits: One made-up task per model and one seed per configuration; no variance across seeds was measured.
The frozen test is reused across rounds; each round's fresh holdout guards against that.
A gain here says nothing about other tasks, real traffic or a harness's end-to-end success.

The submitting key belongs to a person, not to a worker that trains or scores.

verbs.title: Train one adapter
verbs.summary: Train one QLoRA or LoRA adapter on the accepted batches, on the worker's own GPU or a free GPU service within its terms, from base weights verified against their noun, and record an adapter card.
verbs.outcome: An adapter card with the adapter's file digests, private and not admitted.

slots.name: learner_spec
slots.description: Pin of the learner spec.

slots.name: base_model
slots.description: Pin of the base model noun with its weight digests.

slots.name: training_batches
slots.description: Pins of the accepted batches.

slots.name: frozen_receipts
slots.description: Pins of every held-out receipt.

network: Only the worker's own GPU, or one free GPU service the requester names, within its terms and quota; only the owned training rows and the pinned base weights go there, and no other host.
steps: Verify every base weight file against the base model noun before the first load.
Train on the accepted batches only, within the learner spec's row and time budget.
Hash the base weights again after training, and every adapter file.
Keep the adapter private with admitted false, and record the GPU, its memory peak and the minutes.

acceptance.check: The output validates against template.adapter-card's schema.
Every base weight file matched its digest before loading.
The base weight digests after training equal those before.
distribution is private and admitted is false.

verbs.title: Score models on dev, the frozen test, the fresh holdout and sanity
verbs.summary: Score the base, the champion and each candidate with greedy decoding: dev to select among candidates, then the frozen test, this round's fresh holdout and the sanity set, by strict exact match row by row.
verbs.outcome: Run records with per-row results and aggregates.

slots.name: models
slots.description: Pins of the base model and the adapter cards to score.

slots.name: frozen_receipts
slots.description: Pins of the receipts of the sets to score on.

network: Only the worker's own machine; no provider and no other host.
steps: Check each set's rows against its receipt before scoring.
Score every row with greedy decoding and strict exact match, in the receipt's id order.
Record the lenient diagnostic beside the strict score; it never decides.

acceptance.check: The output validates against template.run-record's schema.
Every run's ids_sha256 equals its receipt's.
Rescoring the stored replies gives the same exact list.

verbs.title: Check that the saved adapter reloads to the same replies
verbs.summary: Reload the saved adapter onto a fresh copy of the base, regenerate the probe rows greedily and require identical replies, require the disabled adapter to reproduce the base, and require unchanged base weights.

slots.name: adapter_card
slots.description: Pin of the adapter card.

slots.name: base_model
slots.description: Pin of the base model noun.

slots.name: run_records
slots.description: Pins of the runs whose replies the probes repeat.

network: Only the worker's own machine; no provider and no other host.
steps: Load a fresh base and the adapter only from files whose digests match their nouns.
Regenerate the probe rows greedily and compare each reply byte for byte.
Disable the adapter and compare with the base's replies; hash the base weights again.

acceptance.check: The output validates against template.reload-check's schema.
passed is true only when regenerated_match equals probe_rows and both other checks hold.

verbs.title: Decide by the pre-registered rule
verbs.summary: Apply the pre-registered rule to the candidate's, champion's and base's evaluations with the integrity results, and record promote_candidate or keep_champion with every check and what it observed.
verbs.outcome: A promotion decision anyone can recompute.

slots.name: promotion_rule
slots.description: Pin of the registered promotion rule.

slots.name: run_records
slots.description: Pins of the candidate's, champion's and base's runs.

slots.name: reload_check
slots.description: Pin of the candidate's reload check.

slots.name: frozen_receipts
slots.description: Pins of the receipts behind those runs.

steps: Confirm the rule and every receipt were registered before the first run they judge.
Run python -m promotion_check decide on the evaluations and the integrity results.
Record keep_champion as a ready result when any check fails; never rerun to get a pass.

acceptance.check: The output validates against template.promotion-decision's schema.
python -m promotion_check decide reproduces the record exactly.
The deciding key differs from the key that trained the candidate.

verbs.title: Move the private champion pointer, or roll it back
verbs.summary: Move the private champion pointer by compare-and-set exactly as a promote_candidate decision says, or, when a person records why, roll it back to the previous champion.
verbs.outcome: A new version of the champion pointer, or no change.

slots.name: champion_pointer
slots.description: Pin of the current champion pointer.

slots.name: promotion_decision
slots.description: Pin of the decision, for a promotion.

slots.name: rollback_record
slots.description: Pin of a person's roll back record, for a roll back.

steps: Promote only on a decision with outcome promote_candidate; on keep_champion, end no_change.
Roll back only with a roll back record a person wrote, naming the reason and the evidence.
Write the pointer by compare-and-set with its pinned version; on a conflict, re-read and stop.

acceptance.check: The output validates against template.champion-pointer's schema.
A promotion names a decision whose outcome is promote_candidate.
A roll back names a roll back record submitted by a person's key.
